review:
A Lunar New Year edition on the collect-and-retrigger formula. Three, four or five scatters give 10, 15 or 20 free spins, and two can get a random top-up.

Up to five random modifiers are picked before each bonus – more money, wild or special symbols, starting at level two, or extra spins – so every round starts differently. Wilds collect money symbols, and every fourth retriggers with 2x, 3x, then 10x. 96.71% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
